literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1 and L2) derive from the same publication (PMC9774254) and describe chimeric CCR8 constructs in which CCR3 extracellular segments (N-term aa 1–38, ECL1 aa 96–111, ECL2 aa 176–207, ECL3 aa 269–285) were domain-swapped into CCR8. The RAP and MAP detection tags are placed at the C-terminus of the chimeric CCR8 backbone, which is intracellular for a GPCR — not on the extracellular face of CCR3. The experimental purpose is antibody epitope mapping of CCR3 extracellular domains, a modality explicitly excluded by the rules ('ANTIBODY EPITOPE MAPPING — where an antibody binds is not where a tag was inserted'). No epitope-tag knock-in, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon/domain-insertion screen, or surface-tag insertion at any specific CCR3 residue is reported in either line. Accordingly, zero sites qualify.
